other_failure_modes.name: Data-dependent feature transformations at inference
other_failure_modes.description: The agent dynamically recomputes data-dependent feature transformations (like skewness checks for log-transforms) on the validation and test sets independently, instead of saving and applying the transformation columns selected on the training set. This causes feature mismatch where columns transformed in training are missing (and filled with zeros) during inference.

summary: The agent implements a generally solid modeling pipeline with correct data splitting, robust objective functions (Huber loss), and multiple seeds to address variance. However, there is a critical execution flaw in the feature engineering pipeline: data-dependent transformations like log and sqrt are re-evaluated on the validation/test sets rather than reusing the exact transformations determined from the training set, leading to missing features and degraded inference.
